BossFX_LavaTrail_Albedo.emission: BossFX_LavaTrail_Emission.png (sRGB off: R glow mask, G threshold, B 0, A 1)
BossFX_LavaTrail_Albedo.use: Cinder Matriarch lava trail: one strip along her trail (LineRenderer Tile, or per-piece quads with a random U offset)
BossFX_LavaTrail_Albedo.threshold: G = heat: a pixel glows while G > cool, cool 0 -> 1 over the 6 s cooling (edges cool first, the molten channel last); emission = R * smoothstep(cool - 0.08, cool, G) * lava colour (1, 0.35, 0.08) x 3; fade albedo alpha out over the last seconds

BossFX_ShardFlash.channels: CG: R white-hot core, star spikes, fragment heads; G glow; B hexagon shock ring; A coverage

_notes.convention: PNG row 0 = top (Unity v = 1). Decal albedo sRGB on, everything else sRGB off. Strips: U along the path (Repeat), V across (Clamp). Low/ = half size.
